text:
maria: kicking off kubeadm GPU cluster bring-up in sa-east1 (edge colocation). preflight done, infra tickets: billing/quota/ASN.
aj: noted. which GPU sku? any spot risk?
maria: A10G for inference; we'll use a mix of reserved and preemptible for batch lanes. keep 2 reserved per zone.
ben: ok. rolling through nodepool prefab: kubelet config tweak for local SSDs + eviction thresholds.
leo: FYI calico mtu needs lowering to 1400 for carrier NAT here.
maria: yes set calico.yaml FELIX_IPIPPREFIX or keep default? we'll patch ipip MTU.
ben: patch snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: projectcalico.org/v3
kind: FelixConfiguration
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  ipipMTU: 1400
```
aj: driver install plan?
maria: plan: init nodes with ubuntu-22.04 base, install nvidia-driver 550, nvidia-container-toolkit, kubelet config service unit with --node-labels=role=gpu,accelerator=A10G, --register-with-taints=nvidia.com/gpu=present:NoSchedule
ben: precise join cmd (example):
```bash
kubeadm token create --print-join-command --ttl 24h
# run on worker: sudo kubeadm join 10.0.0.10:6443 --token ... --discovery-token-ca-cert-hash sha256:...
```
leo: remember to install nvidia-device-plugin as DaemonSet after drivers.
infra-bot: driver-sanity-check: all 3 staging nodes report GPU available: false -> waiting for host drivers
maria: thanks infra-bot. submitting runbook step: install drivers on nodes-ssp-1..3
aj: network e2e checks: iptables conntrack size, kube-proxy ipvs mode recommended for perf.
ben: kube-proxy mode set to ipvs in kube-proxy ConfigMap; ensure ipvs modules present in kernel.
maria: post-join validation checklist:
- nodes Ready + label role=gpu
- nvidia-device-plugin pods Running on each node
- kubernetes node-exporter metrics show GPU SM usage
- kube-proxy ipvs rules populated
- calico BGP peering established across edge routers
- coredns latency < 50ms
leo: quick commands:
`kubectl get nodes -o wide` 
`kubectl get ds -n kube-system nvidia-device-plugin` 
`kubectl logs -n kube-system daemonset/nvidia-device-plugin` 
`kubectl get pods -o wide -A | grep calico`
maria: cost note: A10G reserved ~ $0.60/hr, preemptible ~ $0.10/hr; aim for 70/30 spot for batch to save ~40%.
aj: also check regional quotas in sa-east1 for GPUs, we had quota caps last month.
ben: I requested +50 GPU quota, pending approval ticket #INV-3421.
leo: handoff: once all validations green, I'll create PR to add cluster to inventory and tag owners `infra/sa-east1`.
infra-bot: cluster-create: kubeadm bootstrap phase completed (control-plane ready)
maria: control-plane up. now bringing up addons: calico, metrics-server, csi, nvidia-device-plugin, local-storage.
ben: testing pod scheduling - run gpu microbenchmark job to verify scheduling + cuda visible devices.
maria: example test job:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: gpu-smoke
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cuda-test
        image: nvidia/cuda:11.7-base
        command: ["nvidia-smi"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
leo: if any node shows "Insufficient GPUs" check kubelet args and driver health.
aj: last ops: set autoscaler profile, nodepool min=2,max=8, scale-down disabled for 30m to avoid flapping.
maria: rollouts: canary user traffic in region for read-only endpoints first, then write lanes.
ben: handoff checklist to oncall (short):
- cluster inventory PR
- quota ticket link
- driver versions and config
- kube-proxy/ipvs note
- cost projection doc link
maria: tagging @leo and @aj for final handoff. small follow-ups later.
leo: noted, will take ownership after green. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: handoff-created: task=CH-2217 assignee=leo
maria: thanks team, closing thread. will update PR and post runbook link in channel.
